# OOMP bolts, nuts and washers

## Summary

A browsable library of bolts, fully threaded hex-head set screws, nuts, washers and threaded rod. Each part has its own record with available models, drawings, labels and supplier information.

**[Browse the hardware catalogue](navigation_oobb/README.md)** · [Open all part folders](parts/)

[![Full-detail render of an M6 × 25 mm hex-head set screw](presentation/images/m6x25-set-screw.png)](parts/hardware_set_screw_m6_25_mm_length/)

Example: [M6 × 25 mm fully threaded hex-head set screw](parts/hardware_set_screw_m6_25_mm_length/). The image is a catalogue render.

## Details

Use the navigation to choose a family and exact size, then open its canonical part folder. The catalogue currently contains **${part_count} part records**.

Depending on the part, its folder includes 3D models, dimensioned drawings, preview images, labels and structured metadata. Full models include thread detail; display models simplify geometry. Refer to the individual record and model notes for dimensions, source evidence and any approximations. These are catalogue models, not verified manufacturing drawings.

Choose matching thread sizes, lengths and hardware types for your project. Installation requirements depend on the selected part and assembly; this repository does not define a single assembly procedure.
